scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “Short Egyptian fractions” (preprints/Short-Egyptian-fractions-September-25-2026/Short-Egyptian-fractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 025 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 25eebdc1f077f245), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every ε > 0 there is an integer mε such that every integer m ≥ mε occurs as an exact denominator in a representation of 1 by distinct positive unit fractions with at most ( 257 log 2 + ε ) log log m terms.
